class.name: UserSettingsProvider
class.brief_description: Settings added to the game's own.
class.description: The sections of settings a game built on this one, or a plugin, adds to the game's ([UserSettings]): in the game's settings' format - each a [code]"title"[/code] and its [code]"settings"[/code], each of a [code]"title"[/code], a [code]"store"[/code], a [code]"key"[/code] and so on - merged into the game's by their titles - and the values of its own settings in the game's presets ([method UserSettings.preset_list]): each preset a [code]"name"[/code] and its [code]"values"[/code] by section and key, merged into the game's preset of that name. A plugin gives one as the library starts, anything else adds one with [method UserSettings.provider_add].

method.name: _get_presets
method.description: The presets' values it adds, in a script.

method.name: _get_sections
method.description: The sections it adds, in a script.
